title: PMSM Current Controller
text: Discrete-time permanent magnet synchronous machine current controller, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Axis prioritization} sets Axis prioritization for voltage limiter; {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d-axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d-axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d-axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q-axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q-axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q-axis anti-windup gain, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero-cancellation and {Enable pre-control voltage} sets the pre-control voltage. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Block sample time -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: Axis prioritization for voltage limiter q-axis (default) | d-axis | d-q equivalence
